name: Long Call (ATM swing)
summary: Buy the ~50 delta call for a 1-3 week directional swing: maximum gamma-per-dollar with a clean 1:1 initial delta.

legs.strike_rule: Strike closest to 0.50 delta (nearest strike to spot)

max_profit: Unlimited: (spot at exit - strike) x 100 - debit

greeks.gamma: positive and maximal for a single long call at this strike
greeks.theta: negative and maximal in absolute dollars for a single long option at this strike
greeks.vega: positive and maximal at ATM - the most IV-sensitive single long option

when_to_use: High-conviction 1-3 week directional swing where you want the delta to grow fast if you are right. Only when IVR < 30, because ATM carries the most vega.
entry_rules: IVR < 30 (ATM has peak vega; do not buy ATM premium into elevated IV)
Directional trigger required: daily close above a 20-day high, or a MACD cross with price above the 50 EMA
Debit <= 2% of equity per position (~$1,000 on $50k)
management_rules: Take profit at +75% of debit (ATM converts faster than OTM; do not hold out for +100%)
Time stop at 21 DTE or 10 trading days held, whichever first
If delta reaches 0.75+, either take profit or roll up to a new 0.50 delta strike and bank the difference
exit_rules: Sell to close at +75%, -40%, 21 DTE, or 10 trading days held
Mandatory flat by 15:30 ET on expiration day to avoid OCC auto-exercise into 100 long shares
assignment_risk: None (long). Auto-exercise risk at expiry only; the 15:30 ET flatten rule covers it.
liquidity_needs: Penny-wide or near-penny ATM markets; OI >= 1000 preferred.
common_mistakes: Treating ATM as safer than OTM - it is the most theta- and vega-expensive strike in dollar terms.
